name: FX Channel Indicator
author: Jonathan Robichaud
description: Shows which mixer channel the FX unit is on (CH 1-4 or MASTER) next to the effect name, blinks that channel's headphone CUE LED, and adds an optional band mode for the FX frequency control (tap LOW / MID / HIGH to combine bands, ALL, or step through LOW, LOW+MID, ALL, MID+HIGH, HIGH with the FX knob) (Settings > Fx > FX Frequency). On EngineX 5.3.0.4 it also adds Reverse Left / Right Jog Wheel (Settings > Fx), using EngineX 5.3.0.5's own jog code; on 5.3.0.5 EngineX's built-in switches are used instead. Built for SC LIVE 4.
